---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or change to MenuKit
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem** (what your game needs that MenuKit does not do)

**Proposed shape** (new backend method, resource field, row type, panel, …)

**Compatibility** — would this change a backend contract, an exported resource field, a theme
type-variation name or a persisted JSON key? Those are Breaking (see CHANGELOG.md).
